hero.label: The Neryva Charter
hero.title: Intelligence for the physical world.
hero.description: We are an independent research laboratory dedicated to solving the hardest problems in robotics, clinical science, and energy through empirical rigor and highly scaled compute.

items.title: Empirical Truth over Dogma
items.description: We do not believe that blindly scaling parameters solves every problem. We rely on rigorous, empirical testing to discover architectures that map efficiently to the underlying physics of the domain.

items.title: Open by Default
items.description: Progress in foundational science belongs to humanity. We are committed to publishing our core findings, open-sourcing our non-critical weights, and contributing to the global research commons.

items.title: The Physical First
items.description: While digital intelligence has accelerated, physical intelligence has lagged. We focus our compute on areas constrained by the laws of thermodynamics, mechanics, and biology.

items.title: Constraint-Driven Design
items.description: A model that cannot be deployed is a theoretical curiosity. We design our algorithms around the strict latency, energy, and hardware constraints of real-world inference systems.

items.name: Fundamental Architecture
items.focus: Developing the next generation of sparse routing, adaptive computation, and sub-quadratic attention mechanisms.

items.name: Applied Systems & Inference
items.focus: Optimizing models for deployment on edge devices, specialized hardware, and constrained energy grids.

items.name: Safety & Alignment
items.focus: Ensuring clinical and robotic AI systems operate with verifiable mathematical bounds and strict ethical alignment.

cta.title: We are looking for exceptional minds.
cta.description: If you are driven to build intelligence that operates in the real world, explore our open roles.
